ex.t: 数据显示，与不常阅读的孩子和青少年相比，经常阅读的孩子和青少年家里有更多的书，为他们购买的书籍更多，父母阅读更频繁，并且父母会为他们留出阅读时间。

ex.s: 16 What did Jim choose to work from home?
ex.t: 16 吉姆选择在家从事什么工作？

ex.s: “I have my degree in education, but I had been staying home with my kids, ” Drewry says.
ex.t: "我有教育学学位，但一直在家带孩子，"德鲁里说。

ex.s: The school grew in popularity so quickly that Drewry realized she would need more space outside her home for the classes.
ex.t: 这所学校迅速走红，德鲁里意识到她需要在家以外找更大的空间来上课。

ex.s: We see scenes of children learning to read at home or at school, with the book as a focus for relations between the generations.
ex.t: 我们看到了孩子们在家或在学校学习阅读的场景，书成为代际关系的焦点。

ex.s: This year, instead of cooking at home for her husband and friends, she celebrated the Chinese New Year with various dishes from local restaurants in Chinatown.
ex.t: 今年，她没有在家为丈夫和朋友做饭，而是用唐人街当地餐馆的各种菜肴来庆祝中国新年。

ex.s: On the day of the accident, Mrs Brown was at work and Eric was at home with his father.
ex.t: 事故当天，布朗太太在上班，埃里克和父亲在家。

ex.s: I wasn't worried about bringing them into my home with my wife and kids.
ex.t: 我并不担心把它们带进我和妻子、孩子共同生活的家里。

ex.s: Summers in the mid-70s were spent at home shooting baskets, hitting a baseball, or throwing a football, preparing for my future as a quarterback on a football team.
ex.t: 70年代中期的夏天，我都在家里投篮、打棒球或扔橄榄球，为我将来当橄榄球队四分卫做准备。

ex.s: As working from home becomes              common, people are finding it easier to combine parenthood with a full-time career.
ex.t: 随着在家工作变得              常见人们发现更容易将育儿与全职事业结合起来。

ex.s: The researchers analyzed video recordings of 53 child-parent pairs during everyday activities at home and found children who play with puzzles between 26 and 46 months of age have better spatial skills when assessed at 54 months of age.
ex.t: 研究者分析了53对亲子在家日常活动中的录像，发现26至46个月大时玩拼图的孩子，在54个月大评估时空间技能更好。

ex.s: But good news is that there’re really only three kinds of decisions you need to make about color in your home: the small ones, the medium ones, and the large ones.
ex.t: 但好消息是，关于家里的颜色，你真正只需要做三种决定：小的、中等的和大的。

ex.s: Researchers have found that there is a direct link between the increase in food eaten outside the home and the rise in   64  (weigh) problems.
ex.t: 研究人员发现，在家外就餐的增加与___64___（weigh）问题的上升之间有直接联系。

ex.s: When I was a little girl, I liked drawing, freely and joyously making marks on the walls at home.
ex.t: 当我还是个小女孩时，我喜欢画画，自由而快乐地在家里墙上涂画。

ex.s: How to have one’s own personal space at home.
ex.t: 如何在家里拥有自己的个人空间。

ex.s: At home, my dad said, "A job’s a big step to growing up.
ex.t: 在家里，父亲说：“工作是人成长的一大步。”

ex.s: She taught her sisters and brothers at home.
ex.t: 在家里教弟弟妹妹。

ex.s: I can, from my computer at home, pull up satellite images of Juan’s village.
ex.t: 我可以在家里的电脑上调出胡安村庄的卫星图像。

defs.def: comfortable and relaxed 舒适自在；无拘无束

ex.s: Two thirds of people aim to improve their comfort while at home.
ex.t: 三分之二的人希望提高居家的舒适度。

defs.def: in sb's own country, not in a foreign country 尤用于报刊新闻

ex.s: For many British people, that can apply to institutions and objects that represent their country’s past-age-old castles, splendid homes… and red phone boxes.
ex.t: 对许多英国人来说，这同样适用于代表他们国家过去的机构和物品——古老的城堡、华丽的宅邸……以及红色电话亭。

ex.s: She generally works with their regular teachers to get lessons and tests being used at their home schools.
ex.t: 伊丽莎白·西姆斯分析了五部伟大小说的最后章节，看看它们包含哪些要点以及如何将其改编用于你自己的作品。

defs.def: if a sports team plays at home, it plays in the town, etc. that it comes from （比赛队）在主场

ex.s: As darkness came over the field and the match ended, the goal keeper, Juan, walked over to me and said in a matter-of-fact way, “In your home, do you have a moon too?” I was surprised.
ex.t: 当夜幕笼罩球场、比赛结束，守门员胡安走到我面前，用一种就事论事的口气说：“在你们家，也有月亮吗？”我很惊讶。

defs.def: away from a person's own house, flat/apartment, etc. 离开家

ex.s: As soon as she graduated from high school she left home to live on Catalina Island off the Californian coast, away from her parents, where she enjoyed a life of sailing and off-road biking.
ex.t: 她一从高中毕业就离开家，住到加州海岸外的卡塔利娜岛上，远离父母，享受航海和越野骑行的人生。

ex.s: Leaving his home.
ex.t: 离开他的家。

ex.s: I studied abroad and later moved away from my parents’ home to look for  51  Through years of  52 , have become respected teacher in school serving high-need students.
ex.t: 我在国外学习，后来离开父母家去寻找____51____，经过多年____52____，已成为一所服务高需求学生的学校里受人尊敬的老师。

ex.s: Leaving his home.
ex.t: 离开家。

defs.def: if a sports team plays away from home, it plays in the town, etc. that its opponent comes from （比赛队）在客场
connected with the place where you live 家的；家庭的

ex.s: Even though I’m a grown woman in my 40s with my own family, it felt scary not to have “home” to go back to.
ex.t: 尽管我已是个40多岁、有自己的家庭的成年女性，没有“家”可以回让我感到害怕。

ex.s: 68 Why did Addie feel happy on her way home?
ex.t: 68 艾迪在回家的路上为什么感到开心？

ex.s: It saddened me to think of how many people there were who didn’t have a place to call home and the only food they got came from a soup kitchen.
ex.t: 想到有那么多人没有称之为家的地方，他们唯一的食物来自施粥所，我感到难过。

ex.s: Generation Xers with young families, like my wife and I, can still find it convenient to have a home phone rather than providing a mobile phone for every family member.
ex.t: 像我和妻子这样有年幼家庭的X世代人，仍然会觉得家中有一部座机电话很方便，而不必为每个家庭成员都配一部手机。

ex.s: On their first trip out, they were greeted with such enthusiasm from the 10 families who’d already established homes there that they decided to join.
ex.t: 第一次实地探访时，已在那里安家的10户人家热情相迎，这让他们决定加入。

ex.s: He helped to cook at home.
ex.t: 汤姆·索亚历险记是一部冒险剧

ex.s: With his heart in his mouth, Kevin grabbed Mrs Hill’s home phone and called the police.
ex.t: 凯文紧张得心都提到了嗓子眼，他抓起希尔太太家的电话报了警。

ex.s: Additionally, from time to time I will assign group work to be completed in class or short assignments to be completed at home, both of which will be graded.
ex.t: 此外，我会不时布置课堂内完成的小组作业或课后完成的短作业，两者都会评分。

ex.s: I think my home falls into that category.
ex.t: 年龄不是唯一的因素；我想这也与你家庭的构成有关。

ex.s: They may transmit electricity to the home.
ex.t: 它们可以将电力传输到家中。

ex.s: Discover William Wordsworth’s inspirational home.
ex.t: 探访William Wordsworth充满灵感的故居。

ex.s: These lights, known as adaptive signals, have led to significant declines in both the trouble and cost of travels between work and home.
ex.t: 这些被称为自适应信号的灯，使上下班通勤的麻烦和成本都显著下降。

ex.s: For the next five years the local park service will monitor and maintain the tree in its new home.
ex.t: 在接下来的五年里，当地公园管理部门将监测并维护这棵树在新家的情况。

ex.s: "That was my home． I was a teenager sitting in the hall． Before you came over， I never realized what a beautiful place I lived in． I never felt lucky before． You thought it was a museum． My feelings about my home changed after that． I've always wanted to thank you．"
ex.t: “那是我家。我当时是个坐在厅里的少年。你来之前，我从没意识到自己住的地方多美。我以前从没觉得自己幸运。你以为那是博物馆。从那以后我对家的感觉变了。我一直想谢谢你。”

defs.def: made or used at home 在家里做的；家用的

ex.s: 37   Some people register a list of things they want or need for their new home at a local or store or stores.
ex.t: 37   有些人在当地的一家或多家商店登记一份他们想要或需要的新家用品清单。

ex.s: They should also prepare plenty of reusable bags to carry their "new" clothes home.
ex.t: 他们还应该准备大量可重复使用的袋子，把"新"衣服运回家。

ex.s: The fun part of the activities is that the kids can eat or take home whatever they make.
ex.t: 活动的有趣之处在于，孩子们可以吃掉或带回家他们做的任何东西。

ex.s: Growing up in San Francisco, Grace Young used to watch her father shop daily in Chinatown for whatever he needed to make traditional Chinese meals at home.
ex.t: 在旧金山长大的格雷丝·杨，常常看着父亲每天在唐人街采购，为他要在家做的传统中餐准备所需的一切。

ex.s: It was my mother's birthday ten years ago, and I decided to surprise her with home-made scrambled eggs.
ex.t: 那是十年前妈妈过生日的时候，我决定做一份自制炒鸡蛋给她一个惊喜。

ex.s: She wishes to go back to her home country.
ex.t: 她希望回到自己的祖国。

ex.s: The D.C. area is home to many outstanding Chinese restaurants, but diners willing to travel outside the city limits will also be rewarded.
ex.t: 华盛顿特区有许多出色的中餐馆，但愿意走出市区就餐的食客也会有所收获。

ex.s: It’s also home to an ancient library.
ex.t: 它还拥有一座古老的图书馆。

ex.s: What do the underlined words "hit home for me" mean in paragraph 2?
ex.t: 第2段中带下划线的词组"hit home for me"是什么意思？

ex.s: With an impressive 2,000-seat concert hall, St David’s Hall is home to the annual Welsh Proms Cardiff.
ex.t: 圣大卫音乐厅拥有令人印象深刻的2000座音乐厅，是每年加的夫威尔士逍遥音乐节的所在地。

ex.s: The New Theatre has been the home of quality drama, musicals, dance and children’s shows for more than 100 years.
ex.t: 100多年来，新剧院一直是优质戏剧、音乐剧、舞蹈和儿童表演的所在地。

ex.s: It doesn’t impress like George Washington’s plantation on the Potomac, but Lincoln’s home in downtown Springfield, Illinois,   56   （prove）irresistible to visitors since it opened to the public.
ex.t: 它不像华盛顿在波托马克河畔的种植园那样令人印象深刻但林肯在伊利诺伊州斯普林菲尔德市中心的故居自向公众开放以来   56   （证明/prove）一直令游客无法抗拒。

ex.s: Benjamin would leave his home shortly.
ex.t: 这只猫会得到一些医疗照顾。

ex.s: We bravely drove off again two hours later after we’d returned home to get the purse and traveler’s checks Mom had forgotten.
ex.t: 第2段： 我们穿过几个州，沿途看到了很多美景。

defs.def: connected with your own country rather than foreign countries 本国的；国内的

ex.s: His love for his home country.
ex.t: 他对祖国的热爱。

defs.def: connected with a team's own sports ground 主场的
to or at the place where you live 到家；向家；在家

ex.s: Paragraph 1:  When Mr and Mrs Green got home, Kevin went to talk to them.
ex.t: 第1段：当格林夫妇回到家时，凯文去和他们说话。

ex.s: A few weeks later, the boy arrived home from university.
ex.t: 几周后，男孩从大学回到家。

ex.s: At the end of each session I return home feeling stronger, lighter, more able to carry on.
ex.t: 每次课程结束时，我回到家感觉更强壮、更轻松，更能继续下去。

ex.s: Back home, Ehlers was troubled by that   45   dog.
ex.t: 回到家后，埃勒斯为那只____45____的小狗感到不安。

ex.s: While we’re doing all this traveling, we can get seasick at sea, airsick in the air and carsick in a car, but we don’t get homesick when we get back home.
ex.t: 我们在做所有这些旅行的同时，在海上会晕船，在空中会晕机，在车里会晕车，但回到家时我们不会想家。

ex.s: SILENCE in big black letters was on signs hung everywhere If she thought you were dressed improperly, she sent you straight back home to change your clothes.
ex.t: 用大写字母写的"安静"标志到处都是如果她觉得你穿得不合适，她会直接让你回家换衣服。

ex.s: Since it wasn't dark yet after the meal, I decided to walk home from the restaurant.
ex.t: 因为饭后天还没黑，我决定从餐厅走路回家。

ex.s: Two hours before my husband came back home from another job interview, my daughter climbed up to grab a glass vase from a high shelf.
ex.t: 在我丈夫又一次面试回家前两小时，我女儿爬上去够高处架子上的一个玻璃花瓶。

ex.s: Luckily, I will go home in two weeks for summer vacations.
ex.t: 幸运的是，两周后我要回家度暑假了。

ex.t: （2）作者为什么没有到达山顶就匆忙回家？给出两个原因。（不超过15个词）

to direct your thoughts or attention towards sth 把（思想、注意力）集中于

ex.t: 作者为什么决定把斑点和条纹送回动物园？
